assertion_results.text: Tasks target both 'trustify-backend' and 'trustify-ui' repositories with at least one task per repo
assertion_results.evidence: task-2 and task-3 have '## Repository\ntrustify-backend'; tasks 1, 4-9 have '## Repository\ntrustify-ui'. summary-comment.md: 'trustify-backend — Tasks 2, 3; trustify-ui — Tasks 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9'.

assertion_results.text: Backend tasks have lower task numbers than the frontend tasks that depend on them
assertion_results.evidence: Backend tasks are 2 and 3. The frontend tasks that depend on them have higher numbers: Task 4 'Depends on: Task 3' and Task 8 'Depends on: Task 3'. The frontend bookend Task 1 depends on nothing. Backend tasks depend on it, not the other way round.

assertion_results.text: UI-facing frontend tasks (pages, components) reference Figma design context mentioning specific PatternFly components and visual specifications — API-layer frontend tasks (API types, client functions, hooks) are exempt from this requirement
assertion_results.evidence: Task 5 (compare page) references Figma in detail: 'Implement the comparison view from the Figma design', 'Section/column spec (Figma, in order)', PF Select/ExpandableSection/Badge/EmptyState/Skeleton, and badge colour tokens. Task 7 says 'keep the PF5 Dropdown ... as specified in Figma'. Task 6 is a UI page task: it modifies src/pages/SbomListPage/SbomListPage.tsx to add checkboxes and a 'Compare selected' button. It names PF5 Table/Button/Tooltip but contains no reference to Figma design context. Not every UI-facing task meets the requirement, so this fails.

assertion_results.text: Cross-repo dependency ordering is enforced: either at least one frontend task explicitly depends on a backend task in its Dependencies section, or all tasks target a shared feature branch where backend tasks have lower task numbers than frontend tasks (implicit ordering via feature-branch workflow)
assertion_results.evidence: task-4-comparison-api-client-and-hook.md Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 3 — Add GET /api/v2/sbom/compare endpoint' (backend). task-8 also depends on Task 3. task-creation-log.md links: 'T4 | T1, T3'.

assertion_results.text: Frontend tasks reference paths from repo-frontend.md; backend tasks reference paths from repo-backend.md
assertion_results.evidence: Backend tasks modify modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/mod.rs, sbom/service/sbom.rs, sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, tests/api/sbom.rs and README.md. All of these appear in repo-backend.md. Frontend tasks modify src/api/models.ts, src/api/rest.ts, tests/mocks/handlers.ts, src/routes.tsx, package.json, src/pages/SbomListPage/SbomListPage.tsx(.test.tsx) and tests/e2e/sbom-list.spec.ts. All of these appear in repo-frontend.md. Backend paths show up in frontend tasks only as cross-repo API contract references.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: All 9 task files have '## Repository' followed by exactly one name: trustify-ui for tasks 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9, trustify-backend for tasks 2 and 3.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: Each of the 9 task files has '## Target Branch', '## Description', '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Test Requirements'. Example: task-1 has Target Branch main, a Description, 2 AC items and 1 Test Requirement. task-9 also has all four.

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the corresponding mock repository structure manifests (repo-backend.md or repo-frontend.md), not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: Every Files to Modify path exists in the matching manifest, e.g. modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, src/routes.tsx, tests/mocks/handlers.ts. Every Files to Create path sits in a manifest directory and follows its patterns: sbom/model/comparison.rs, sbom/endpoints/compare.rs, src/hooks/useSbomComparison.ts, tests/mocks/fixtures/sbom-comparison.json, src/pages/SbomComparePage/... (mirrors SbomDetailPage/components/), src/utils/exportComparison.ts and tests/e2e/sbom-compare.spec.ts.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every non-bookend, non-documentation task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance — bookend tasks (create-branch, merge-branch) and documentation tasks are exempt as they omit Implementation Notes by design
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 2-7 all have specific Implementation Notes. Task 2 cites entity/src/sbom_package.rs, package_license.rs, common/src/error.rs and 'follow modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/summary.rs'. Task 3: 'Follow the handler shape of modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/get.rs'. Task 4: 'follow src/hooks/useSbomById.ts'. Task 5: src/utils/severityUtils.ts, SeverityBadge and useSearchParams. Task 6: src/components/FilterToolbar.tsx and useNavigate. Task 7: src/utils/formatDate.ts and Blob/URL.createObjectURL.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section — either all set to 'main' (direct-to-main workflow) or bookend tasks set to 'main' with intermediate tasks set to the feature issue ID (feature-branch workflow)
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 (create-branch) and Task 9 (merge-branch) have Target Branch 'main'. Tasks 2-8 have Target Branch 'TC-9003'. task-creation-log.md table confirms this, and workflow-mode-comment.md records 'Selected mode: feature-branch'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: There are 9 digest files, task-1-digest.md through task-9-digest.md, one per task. Each contains '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<hex>', e.g. task-1: sha256-md:8aeec66fc6cdc1fe3df04a424f805c71c787139cbfa27006336c079e10e67054. All 9 hashes were checked and are 64 lowercase hex characters.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Every 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §...' line in tasks 2-7 is followed by a rationale in the prescribed format that names a specific file. Example from task-3: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs` matching the convention's endpoint route-registration (`endpoints/mod.rs`) scope.' Example from task-4: 'Applies: task modifies `src/api/rest.ts` matching the convention's `src/api/` + `src/hooks/` API-layer scope.' Some lines use 'task creates <file>' for Files to Create, which the rules allow. Backend tasks do not list frontend conventions, and frontend tasks do not list backend conventions. grep for 'Not applicable'/'N/A' across the task files returns no matches.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The Feature fixture has 'Priority: Critical'. task-creation-log.md: 'Priority: **Critical** (set on Feature, not "Undefined") → propagated to all Epics and Tasks', with additional_fields '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}'. Every task file header shows '**Priority:** Critical'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The Feature fixture has 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0' and the config has 'fixVersion scope: both'. task-creation-log.md: 'fixVersions: **RHTPA 1.5.0** (non-empty) and `fixVersion scope: both` → propagated to all Epics and Tasks', with '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. Every task header shows '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.5.0'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md has an '## Inherited field values' section: 'Priority: Critical. Propagated to all Epics and Tasks.' and 'fixVersion: RHTPA 1.5.0. Propagated to all Epics and Tasks, because `fixVersion scope` = both.'
